name: Zero-DTE Covered Call
summary: Sell a same-day-expiry OTM call against held ETF shares every session, harvesting the last day of theta and buying it back before the close.

legs.strike_rule: 0.10-0.15 delta computed locally (Alpaca returns no 0DTE greeks) using intraday T = minutes_to_1600ET / (252 x 390)

max_profit: credit received x 100 (typically 0.05-0.20% of notional per day)
max_loss: share downside for the session, less the credit; upside capped above the strike

greeks.gamma: very negative and accelerating into the close
greeks.theta: large positive per hour but small in dollars

when_to_use: Only on liquid index ETFs, on days without a scheduled 08:30/10:00 ET macro release, when the overnight gap has already been absorbed. Enter after 10:00 ET once the opening range is set.
entry_rules: Restrict to SPY, QQQ, IWM, DIA and other ETFs with penny-wide 0DTE strikes and OI >= 1000.
Do not enter before 10:00 ET or after 14:30 ET.
Compute delta locally from a Black-Scholes fit to the 0DTE chain; require computed |delta| in [0.08, 0.16].
Require credit >= 0.03% of notional (e.g. >= 0.18 on a $600 SPY) - otherwise the assignment risk is unpaid.
Skip the day if VIX1D > 25 or if a FOMC/CPI/NFP release is scheduled that session.
One 0DTE call per 100 shares; never more contracts than share lots.
management_rules: Take profit at 65% of the credit (buy-to-close <= 0.35 x credit).
Hard stop: buy back if the call price reaches 2.5x the credit received.
Do not roll intraday to a further strike - close and stand down for the session.
exit_rules: ABSOLUTE: buy to close by 15:30 ET regardless of price, ITM or OTM. No 0DTE short leg is ever held into the close.
Immediate close if spot comes within 0.25% of the strike at any time after 14:30 ET.
assignment_risk: Assignment only happens at expiry for a 0DTE equity/ETF call, but exercise-by-exception triggers at $0.01 ITM and the shares get called away with no warning. The 15:30 ET flatten rule is the entire defense. Alpaca also begins risk-based handling of expiring positions late in the session - do not rely on it.
liquidity_needs: Penny-wide 0DTE chains only; reject any strike quoting wider than 0.05.
common_mistakes: Selling too close to the money for a few extra cents; letting a winner ride past 15:30 ET; running 0DTE overwrites on single-name stocks where the chain is illiquid and gap risk is brutal.
zero_dte_notes: This is the flagship 0DTE strategy for a share-settled account because the short leg is always covered. The whole edge is in the discipline of the 15:30 ET flatten and the 0.10-0.15 delta strike.
family: Stock/ETF Shares Combined With Options (covered writes, protective hedges, collars, synthetics, repairs, conversions)
